title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Strategy 4th BTC sale in 2026: 1,690 BTC (~$109M) sold Aug 3–9 to fund STRC buybacks; still holds 840,447 BTC.
BIP-110 fork defeated: miners chose original Bitcoin; data-limit chain stalled after 2 blocks.
No price thresholds triggered (BTC +0.4%, ETH -0.1%, Oil +2.9%, Gold -0.2%, S&P +0.1%).
Ahead: CPI Jul on Wed Aug 12 — key catalyst for Sept Fed rate-hike odds.
